svg.title: Virgin Mary Farm: proposed equipment needs
svg.desc: Water restoration first, followed by assessment-led machinery and tools. No prices are confirmed. The equipment is proposed, not already purchased.

g.text: Water first. Then grow, train and rebuild.
Omdurman, Khartoum, Sudan · A plan to develop with partners
Match capacity to the growing area
Assess → Design → Agree support → Deliver safely
Proposed equipment, not existing assets or confirmed purchases.
Specifications, quantities and costs will follow technical assessment.
